svg.text: Pareto Frontier: Calibration Error (ECE) vs. Fairness Violation (DP Diff)
Each candidate model plotted by calibration error against fairness violation, with the non-dominated frontier
highlighted. Frontier points are the best achievable trade-offs; points inside the frontier are dominated - worse
